prompt:
Authors are written both 'First Last' and 'Last, First'; group them.

1. `shelf/catalog.py`: add a module-level function `author_key(name)`: if the name contains a comma, `'Last, First'` becomes `'First Last'` (split at the first comma); then lower-case it, remove periods, collapse whitespace runs to one space and strip. So `'Kernighan, Brian'`, `'brian  kernighan'` and `'Brian Kernighan'` all give `'brian kernighan'`, and `'J.R.R. Tolkien'` gives `'jrr tolkien'`. Add `Catalog.by_author(name)`: the books whose author has the same `author_key` as `name`, sorted by `(year, title)`.
2. `shelf/reports.py`: add `author_ranking(desk, n=10)`: a list of `(display_name, loan_count)` over all loans ever, authors grouped by `author_key`. The display name is the author string of that author's book with the smallest ISBN in the catalog. Sort by count descending, then display name; at most `n` entries; authors with no loans are left out.

Keep the existing tests passing (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
